A Google Analytics alternative that’s
privacy-focused
and
cookie-free
Fathom helps you understand your website visitors without spying on them. That’s why thousands of companies, from bootstrapped software companies to Fortune 100s, trust Fathom for their website analytics.
Don’t clutter your website with cookie banners
You don’t need a consent banner that annoys visitors, clutters your layout and slows the page down. Fathom
doesn’t use cookies
, so you can keep analytics on your site without the pop-up.
Protect the privacy of your website visitors
We’re GDPR, ePrivacy, PECR and CCPA compliant because digital privacy sits at the core of the product. We’ve had privacy lawyers vet how we collect and store data, and EU visitor data is processed in the EU automatically.
Read about data isolation
See humans, not bots
We filter out bots, crawlers, DDoS junk and other non-human traffic, so your dashboard is a picture of people who actually visited. Data shows up in real time, not 24 to 48 hours later.
Get the information you need to make decisions
See which pages are popular, who’s sending traffic, which campaigns are converting and which events are paying off, all from one dashboard. Add a filter and you can drill into a campaign, a country or a single page

We’re standing up to big tech
Big tech companies promised us all the moon but delivered us a dumpster fire instead. They told us that we could have “free” software, then made billions from it by abusing our data without our consent.
Google Analytics has its tracking code on
85% of websites
on the internet. They don’t charge customers for their software because mining our private habits and targeting us with ads is so darn profitable to them.
As citizens of the internet ourselves, we knew the internet deserved better. That’s why we invented the world’s first simple, privacy-first analytics software: Fathom Analytics.
Fathom at a glance
2018
The year we started
Billions
Of pageviews processed
Millions
Of customer websites
Thousands
Of paying customers
Self-funded
Sustainable and profitable
Zero
Personal data sold
Fathom is used by companies who care about your privacy
The story (so far)
Fathom Analytics started with a tweet and a screenshot.
We were frustrated because website analytics hadn’t innovated. So we sat down and drew up what we thought a dashboard could look like if we didn’t compromise simplicity and privacy.
That screenshot was posted for fun, but it spread like wildfire. Soon hundreds of people were offering to pay us for the real thing. So,
